name: Take, Deposit, Restock
jem_summary: Use Deposit to move an item into storage and Restock to replenish the backpack from storage.

pages.title: Take, Deposit, Restock
pages.text: Use Deposit to move an item into storage and Restock to replenish the backpack from storage.

pages.title: Take, Deposit, Restock
pages.text: Distinguish deposit from restock; upgrade bases and a barrel support your own transfer point.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Sneak-interact with the target inventory. Filters select transfer contents; Refill is a separate upgrade that maintains a selected player-inventory stack, with advanced slot targeting.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Deposit moves selected backpack contents into a sneak-interacted inventory; advanced adds filtering.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Restock replenishes the backpack from a sneak-interacted inventory, the reverse direction of Deposit.
